review: The target-bound projectile is a narrow extension of SimProjectile because it has one concrete caller and carries the behavioral invariant that the guardian does not retarget.
Guardian state reuses ActiveMine ground-placement and observer events; the distinct shot path remains in BattleSimulation so terrain damage and radial mine damage cannot leak into the guardian round.
The acceptance test still asserts deploy, trigger, shot, direct damage, and target-turn termination through public BattleSimulation entry points. No assertion was relaxed or removed.
The repository had substantial pre-existing edits in these shared files; review was limited to guardian-specific hunks. git diff --check reported no whitespace errors.
